# Libre AI

Current portfolio map: profile/README.md (English), profile/README.fr.md (French).

Use the current README and agent instructions of the relevant repository. Repository names identify ownership, not capability availability. Keep implemented behavior, proposed contracts, future scopes and test fixtures distinct. Canonical contracts belong to schemas-and-contracts; shared rules belong to project-governance.

Each repository's own project card is the authority on what that project has proven. Do not infer availability from the presence of code, a passing check or an open pull request.

Do not infer current behavior from historical sources, private migration records or previous agent summaries. Reconcile the current revision and relevant evidence before making claims. Do not publish secrets or personal data.

The short-name generation that preceded this portfolio (feed-radar, notebook, policy, governance, contracts and others) was retired on 2026-10-07 after a verified archive. Its names are historical: do not resolve them, and do not treat a document that mentions them as describing a current repository.
